name: McMillan Shakespeare Limited
summary: McMillan Shakespeare Limited provides salary packaging, novated leasing, disability plan management, support coordination, asset management, and related financial products and services in Australia and New Zealand. It operates through Group Remuneration Services; Asset Management Services; and Plan and Support Services segments. The Group Remuneration Services segment offers administrative services in respect of salary packaging and facilitating motor vehicle novated leases for customers. This segment also provides ancillary services associated with motor vehicle novated lease products, including novated lease finance.
